cohort: The study included 8-year-olds identified with ASD and/or ID (N=18,169) matched to birth records, compared to a birth cohort of 1,456,914 births from corresponding birth years and counties in US surveillance areas.
finding: Overall, increased odds of disability were associated with primary and repeat C-section, though adjusted models stratified by region showed significant variability, suggesting C-section may serve as a proxy for regionally variable exposures rather than being the direct cause.
mod_finding: Overall models indicated increased odds of disability associated with primary and repeat C-section, but this association varied significantly by region (Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, West) for repeat C-sections, suggesting the procedure itself might not be the direct cause.
